visualCharacteristics.summary: Brand tab (logo) + contact panel: photo, title, team, department, team CTA
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Garage brand contact module — a strip of brand-logo tabs (active underlined dark blue) above a grey panel with the team photo (left half at >= 768px) beside the headline, bold team name, grey department line and the dark-blue icon CTA. The section head (eyebrow + `<h2>`) is default content before the block and is reabsorbed (eyebrow | headline)
visualCharacteristics.differsFromBase: Color + purpose (contact) + density match; captured cta-band has no image, and the brand-logo tab strip + 50/50 image/grey panel layout are new.
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked and centred below 768px; photo 50% | info 50% at >= 768px
visualCharacteristics.interaction: brand tabs switch panels (click, Enter/Space, arrow keys)
